selection: Named first-wave cities from the approved Nov 21 growth plan (Austin, Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Waco, El Paso, Longview, Lubbock, Tyler, Victoria), then the next 10 highest-impression city pages from the Nov 13 Search Console Pages.csv export that were not already in that list: Burleson, McAllen, Amarillo, Rockwall, Laredo, Granbury, Weatherford, Arlington, Sealy, Canton.

cities.getting_a_home_delivered_paragraph: Texas Homes Direct delivers new manufactured homes to Arlington from our lot at 4580 FM 2438 in Seguin, about 253 driving miles away. Delivery is priced per mile from the lot. We do not publish a per-mile rate here. In Texas, delivery and setup usually take 1–2 days. For permits and placement rules, check with Tarrant County. We do not list permit fees or timelines because those come from the county.
